snippet.title: Microbiote et FIV : faut-il tester avant transfert ?
snippet.description:
Le microbiote vaginal peut-il influencer le transfert d'embryon ? Cette vidéo explique le rôle des lactobacilles, les tests possibles et les limites des traitements avant une FIV.

⏱️ Timestamps 

0:00 — Pourquoi un embryon parfait échoue ?
0:24 — L’erreur : on oublie l’entrée de l’hôtel
1:29 — Propreté ≠ microbiote sain
1:58 — Lactobacilles & crispatus, les gardiens
3:00 — Dysbiose : les “fêtards” prennent le pouvoir
3:45 — Inflammation = implantation sabotée
4:43 — Données 2025 : succès divisé par deux
5:43 — Tester – Traiter – Reconstruire
6:08 — Antibiotiques = bombe atomique
7:11 — Probiotiques ciblés
7:40 — Pas de transfert dans un couloir en feu
8:17 — “Et le couloir, Docteur ?”

en-US.title: Microbiota and IVF: The ESSENTIAL Test to Perform Before Any Embryo Transfer
en-US.description:
Your embryo is AA grade, your uterine lining is triple-layered, everything is "perfect," and yet, your in vitro fertilization (IVF) treatment failed. If this question is haunting you, this video by Dr. Senai Aksoy is for you. We'll explore the invisible factor that studies say halves the IVF pregnancy rate: vaginal dysbiosis, or an imbalanced microbiota.

Dr. Aksoy uses the analogy of a VIP hotel to explain why the state of the "hallway" (vagina) is just as crucial as the "room" (endometrium). Learn how to restore the balance of your flora to create a welcoming environment for your embryo transfer and significantly increase your chances of success. ZERO NONSENSE, just applied science.

The Haunting Question: Failure Despite a Perfect Embryo and Lining.

The Hotel Hallway: The Unsung Role of the Vagina in IVF.

Eubiose and Lactobacilli: The Soldiers Protecting Your Uterus.

The Dysbiosis Trap: Why the Balance Is Disrupted and Who Takes Control.

The Silent Alarm: How Dysbiosis Causes Chronic Endometritis.

The Science by the Numbers: The Real Impact of Abnormal Flora on Live Birth Rates.

The Promise: Why This Factor Is Modifiable (It's Not Inevitable).

Dr. Aksoy's Action Plan (1. Test, 2. Treat the Cause, 3. Rebuild).

Reforestation: The Role of Specific Probiotics for Effective Regeneration.

The Essential Question to Ask Your IVF Doctor.

For couples struggling with infertility and seeking solutions for repeated transfer failures, Dr. Aksoy's scientific and empathetic approach offers a fresh perspective on infertility treatment.
